title: Daria Gonzalez, whose agency built the book's brand, takes 'harder is easier' to marketing — 'companies discover their values in moments when two things they care about conflict'
summary: Wunderdogs worked on the Incorruptible release — the agency is already credited on the site launch — and its co-founder used the access to interview Eric about marketing leadership. The full conversation is published on Wunderdogs' site. Her three takeaways run from bringing finance into the brand conversation, to the value of a specific point of view, to the one she leads with: that companies do not start out knowing their values but find them at the points where two commitments collide, and that the good outcome is refusing to drop either. 'Harder is easier' is Eric's own named principle, not her coinage.
blockquote: Long term, harder is easier. Companies don't start out knowing their values; they discover them in moments when two things they care about conflict. The best results come when you push your team to find a way to deliver both.
